items.caption: A modern redraw in small-seal style has a rounded U-shaped outer outline and a taller central stem that forks into two diagonal arms meeting the outline near the bottom. It illustrates a later seal-style form, but does not show how the character’s shape changed over time.
items.alt: A rounded U-shaped outline encloses a central stem that forks into two diagonal arms near the bottom.
items.selection_reason: The visible outer outline and central fork make this seal-style form useful for illustrating a later graphic form of 山. The redraw is not an ancient specimen and cannot establish a sequence of changes.
items.period: Seal-script tradition; specimen date not established

limitations.text: This modern digital redraw shows a seal-script-style form, not an ancient inscription. The available evidence does not establish a date for the depicted specimen or a continuous sequence of graphic changes.
